alex_ar: FYI Skyline Biotech invoice INV-2026-782 ($7,300) hit a returned ACH (R04). Batch id ach_77321.
maria_billing: noted. do we have a backup card or token?
rachel_cs: customer says finance team is reconciling and asked for a 14-day hold. preferrable to avoid collections — they asked for a partial payment of $2,000 today.
noah_collections: policy: one manual retry allowed for R04 within 5 business days. For partial payments we need finance + legal ok and a signed installment plan. @lena_legal can we allow 3-part split with waiver of one late fee?
lena_legal: legal is fine with a 3-part split provided there is a signed agreement and explicit card fallback consent. also require note in contract system about collections hold.
maria_billing: finance approves conditional waiver if: 1) $2,000 is paid today, 2) signed plan uploaded by EOD + saved card for autopay. set dunning pause for 14 days.
collections_bot: Action: INV-2026-782 status set to "hold_for_payment_plan". Next notice paused until 2026-04-09.
alex_ar: i've emailed the payment link and attached the installment template. customer replied "ok to pay $2,000 now, will sign and provide card by EOD."
rachel_cs: uploaded their emailed signed PDF to the portal (file attached). customer asked that service not be interrupted.
maria_billing: scheduled manual ACH retry for $2,000 now. if retry fails, charge card token once received. created AR watch ticket and reminder for 2026-04-09.
noah_collections: logged MANUAL_RETRY at 2026-03-31T11:05Z. will escalate if the remainder isn't on autopay within 14 days.
alex_ar: closing thread pending retry outcome. will update if charge returns. closing ts 1987654356
